test_Index_repeat: test the Index.repeat method to repeat each element of an index a specified number of times
test_Index_insert: test the Index.insert method to insert a value at a given position in an index
test_Index_delete: test the Index.delete method to remove an element at a given position from an index
test_Index_append: test the Index.append method to concatenate multiple indexes together
test_Index_insert_bool_numeric: test inserting boolean values into numeric extension array indexes without silent casting
